// tag::body[]
A token bucket rate limit backed by Redis, shared across all Redpanda Connect instances that use the same Redis instance.

ifndef::env-cloud[]
Introduced in version 4.12.0.
endif::[]

This rate limit uses a token bucket algorithm to limit the number of requests to a given `count` within a given `interval`. The rate limit is shared across all instances of Redpanda Connect that use the same Redis instance, which must all have a consistent `count` and `interval`.
// end::body[]
